theme: A gentle day built around Mike's recovery.
greeting: The day is open and quiet, Dan — a couple of small errands, then the drive to Rockland at noon. With Mike still mending from surgery, there's no rush in any of it.

needsAttention.title: Pack the small travel bags this morning
needsAttention.detail: Your 'Organize small bags for travel' task (Inbox) has sat open since Aug 17, and you're on the road to Rockland by noon — worth clearing before you leave.

recipe.title: Roast Sugar-Sprinkled Peaches
recipe.why: High summer means peaches at their most fragrant, and a hot oven concentrates their honeyed sweetness.

acts.line: Juliano stops by at 9:30 and there's clothing to mail by 11 — small errands before you head out.
You drive to Rockland at noon; the Forester keys are the one thing not to forget.
Mike is still recovering from oral surgery, so keep the evening soft and low-key.
